description.content:
Public endpoint returning Okta configuration for the frontend SPA.
No authentication required — these are public OIDC public-client (PKCE)
values that are necessarily exposed in the browser to begin the login flow.
The redirect URI is intentionally NOT returned: the SPA derives it from
its own origin, so it never needs to be served to unauthenticated callers.
List admin action audit logs (who changed what on API keys and OAuth clients).
Rotate OAuth1 credentials for a tenant.
Validate OAuth1 credentials without storing them.
Create a UI session. Validates an Okta token (or dev-mode flag) and sets a session cookie.
